description: Ralph module configuration for ralph-og-modular. Ralph can modify this file to enable/disable personality modules during loops.

usage.example_command: jq '.enabled_modules += ["crabs"]' ralph-modules.json > tmp.json && mv tmp.json ralph-modules.json

notes: Modules are reloaded EVERY iteration - changes take effect immediately!
Ralph can add/remove modules mid-loop by editing this file
Create your own modules by adding new .md files
